children: , Venzee Technologies Inc.) is pleased to announce that it has entered into a new consulting agreement (the “
”) with its majority shareholder, Digital Commerce Payments Inc. (“
”), which supersedes and replaces the existing consulting services arrangements between JasperX and DCP.
Pursuant to the Agreement, DCP will provide JasperX with general advisory, accounting, sales and marketing services and legal support (the “

”) at a level and scope substantially consistent with DCP’s past practice of providing the Services or as modified by mutual written agreement of JasperX and DCP. The term of the Agreement will, subject to approval, retroactively commence and be effective as of January 1, 2026 and continue for one year, with automatic renewal for successive one-year periods unless at least 60 days prior notice is given by either party of its intention not to renew the term of the Agreement prior to the end of the then-current term. DCP may terminate the Agreement on not less than 30 days’ prior written notice to JasperX, and JasperX may terminate the Agreement on 180 days’ prior written notice to DCP. Either party may also terminate the Agreement on notice to the other party in the event of such other party’s uncured breach of the Agreement, and DCP may terminate the Agreement immediately upon the occurrence of an insolvency event involving JasperX.

JasperX will pay DCP a fee of $15,000 per month (plus applicable sales taxes) for its services, payable in cash. Any unpaid amounts will accrue interest at a rate of 12% per annum, and JasperX will grant to DCP a continuing first priority security interest in and to all of JasperX’s present and after acquired property, and all proceeds thereof, to secure payment of any amounts owing to DCP under the Agreement. The Agreement also reflects a reduced fee as compared to the previous consulting agreements which included a fee of $30,000 per month.

The Agreement has been approved by the board of directors of JasperX, with representatives from DCP abstaining, and the Agreement has been accepted by the TSX Venture Exchange pursuant to TSXV Policy 3.2 –

JasperX unlocks Shareholder value by carrying out its mission to create intelligent technology that empowers companies to optimize their ecommerce execution and win on the digital shelf. Its modern PIM/PXM platform disrupts and displaces inefficient manual processes in favor of integrated, machine-driven solutions. To learn more about the JasperX platform, visit https://jasperpim.com.

In a world where innovation and disruption are key to success, DCP is leading the charge with cutting-edge digital payment solutions. From seamless integrations to fully customizable options, DCP helps its customers put fast, reliable solutions at the heart of their businesses. DCP was incorporated under the laws of the Province of Alberta and is not a “reporting issuer” under applicable securities legislation in any jurisdiction and its securities are not listed for trading on any stock exchange. To learn more about DCP, visit https://dc-payments.ca.

All information contained in this news release with respect to JasperX and DCP was supplied by the parties respectively, for inclusion herein, without independent review by the other party, and each party and its directors and officers have relied on the other party for any information concerning the other party.
